findings.claim: The submitted diff declares the new affirmation, session, gate-adapter, and migration modules but contains none of their source or migration files, so the patch cannot establish a buildable durable-affirmation implementation.
findings.evidence: The standard packet omitted untracked files required by acceptance criterion 1.2.
findings.resolution: Packet defect: the corrected packet includes every untracked RA-02 inventory file.

findings.claim: The gateway policy cannot ship from this change because the hook implementation was absent from the packet.
findings.evidence: The standard single-repository packet omitted the companion flint-gate diff.
findings.resolution: Packet defect: the corrected packet includes tracked and untracked companion flint-gate changes.

findings.claim: The hook's second string argument silently changes meaning from actor ID to practice ID without a caller migration.
findings.evidence: The incomplete packet contained no untracked test caller hunk.
findings.resolution: The complete review retained this as a warning; iteration 2 replaced the positional value with a typed options object.
